claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value to usage-based forecasting and repeatable commercialization.
Strengthened production reliability with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, combining evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates from intake through monitoring, using managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS, Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
